target.title: fix(telegram): harden rich send fallback and typing breaker
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

This PR fixes the two Telegram reliability gaps from #99471 that still remain on current `main`:

- **Typing breaker is too aggressive:** `createTypingCallbacks` defaults to only 2 consecutive start failures before stopping the keepalive. Two transient `sendChatAction` failures can silence typing feedback for a still-running reply across all channel surfaces.
- **Missing `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` classification:** The rich-plain fallback system in `rich-plain-fallback.ts` classifies `RICH_MESSAGE_*_INVALID` and HTML parse errors, but `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` (400) is not recognized. A chunk that produces a content-required rejection aborts delivery instead of falling back to plain text.
- **No empty-rich guard before `sendRichMessage`:** Both the durable chunk loop (`send.ts`) and the streaming funnel (`delivery.send.ts`) can call the Bot API with empty rendered rich HTML, which reliably produces `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`.

The rich-message reply-context extraction portion of #99471 is already fixed on current `main`.

Closes #99471

## Summary

- Raise the shared typing-breaker default from 2 to 5 consecutive failures via a named constant (`DEFAULT_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_TYPING_FAILURES`) in `src/channels/typing.ts`. Explicit `maxConsecutiveFailures` overrides and the existing success-reset behavior are unchanged.
- Extend `getTelegramPlainFallbackTrigger` in `rich-plain-fallback.ts` to return `"rich-content-required"` for `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`, so both durable and streaming send funnels re-use the existing `buildTelegramPlainFallbackPlan` mechanism.
- Guard empty rendered rich HTML in both send funnels:
  - `extensions/telegram/src/send.ts` — durable chunk loop skips unsendable empty-rich chunks or falls back to `chunk.plainText` when available.
  - `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts` — streaming funnel falls back to the plain-text path before calling `sendRichMessage`.
- Add regression tests for the default typing breaker, delivery-side and durable-side `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` fallback, and the empty-rich guard.

The branch has been rebased onto upstream/main (`f27d494d00e`) and adapted to the post-refactor `rich-plain-fallback.ts` architecture. The conflicting QA OTEL output-dir hunk from the original PR has been removed because current main already contains the equivalent fix via `resolveQaOutputDir` in commit `26cb189276af`.

## Evidence

### Local lightweight precheck

- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check` on all changed files — passed
- `git diff --check` on all changed files — passed

### Independent fork CI verification

A full CI run was performed against the PR branch on the contributor's fork (`snowzlmbot/openclaw`):

- Run: <https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28694679021>
- Result: **103 passed, 0 failed (code-related), 6 skipped, 1 QA smoke infra timeout** 
- The single QA smoke failure is a known infrastructure OOM (`tsdown` + `plugin-lifecycle-matrix` heap pressure in a 2‑vCPU runner), not related to this PR's changes.

All type checks, lint checks, package-boundary checks, build-artifacts, and Node test shards (including the typing, Telegram send, and delivery test files modified in this PR) passed on the fork.

### Upstream PR CI history

Earlier upstream CI runs on the same branch (before the repo refactor that moved error-predicate location) showed all type/lint/test/build checks passing. The current rebased version surfaces the same test assertions adapted to the `rich-plain-fallback.ts` structure.

### Regression coverage added

| Test file | Coverage |
|---|---|
| `src/channels/typing.test.ts` | Default breaker runs through five consecutive start failures before stopping; non-finite override also defaults to five. |
| `extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts` | Durable rich send falls back to plain text on `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`. |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` | Delivery rich send falls back to plain text on `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`. |
| `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` | Empty rich text is rejected before calling raw `sendRichMessage`. |

### Live Telegram proof applicability

Live Telegram Desktop real-behavior proof is not claimed for this PR because the fix targets Telegram Bot API rejection conditions (`RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` / empty rich payload) that cannot be safely reproduced through normal user-visible Telegram Desktop interaction. The unit tests directly exercise the exact Bot API error messages and fallback behavior using the same shared `buildTelegramPlainFallbackPlan` path that production code uses.

## Risk

Low to moderate:

- **Typing feedback** may retry longer during transient channel typing failures, but still stops after a bounded number of consecutive failures (5, up from 2). This default applies to all `createTypingCallbacks` callers — not only Telegram — so maintainers should explicitly accept the shared default or scope it before merge.
- **Rich-message fallback** only catches Telegram rich validation/content-required errors; unrelated send failures still propagate.
- **Empty rich chunks** without sendable plain text are skipped in the durable chunk loop so later valid chunks can still deliver.
- **No regression for existing callers:** the fallback trigger map was extended with an additional string literal, and callers that match on `getTelegramPlainFallbackTrigger` should still handle unrecognized trigger values gracefully (existing callers check `!fallbackPlan` rather than exhaustive matching).
